articles.title: Binance hackers stole 192 tokens across 11 networks, court docs show
articles.description: Stablecoins accounted for at least $3.46 billion of the $6.3 billion stolen, while the hackers also took memecoins, tokenized gold and gaming tokens.

articles.title: Trump administration unveils new center to choke off scam payments
articles.description: Americans reported more than $17.7 billion in online fraud losses in 2025.

articles.title: Fed officials saw October rate hold as a ‘close call,’ minutes show
articles.description: The latest FOMC minutes suggest greater appetite for higher rates than the Fed’s 10–2 vote indicated, with markets now pricing in a December hike.

articles.title: Tether invokes The Big Short in swipe at S&P over USDT reserve risks
articles.description: S&P Global made no downward adjustment in its latest Stablecoin Stability Assessment, as 5 is the lowest available score.

articles.title: Ledger warns Berlin customers as hardware wallet tampering investigation expands
articles.description: Ledger advised customers who purchased devices in Berlin since January 2026 to contact support as it investigates suspected hardware implants in Germany and Dubai.

articles.title: Bain Capital Crypto leads $110M Variational round at $1.5B valuation
articles.description: Variational raised $110 million at a $1.5 billion valuation to expand Omni’s derivatives markets and increase trading limits.

articles.title: Binance says it obtained $6.5B worldwide freezing order after hack
articles.description: The court orders allow legal notices to be served via blockchain and provide for a continuously updated list of 26,000 wallet addresses linked to stolen assets, Binance’s lawyers said.

articles.title: MARA prices $185M debt offering after $1.1B Bitcoin sale
articles.description: The Bitcoin miner is taking on new debt to finance its AI infrastructure expansion, with the Long Ridge acquisition adding nearly $69 million in annual interest costs.

articles.title: $25M Ethereum MEV acquittal tests criminal enforcement limits
articles.description: BlackRock’s staked Ether ETF earns a cut of what traders pay for priority on Ethereum, the acquittal left the legal risk to that income unresolved.

articles.title: Polymarket US takes rapid-fire crypto trading format to oil, natural gas
articles.description: Polymarket US said it attracted more than 300,000 traders to its short-duration crypto markets in six weeks and is now expanding the format to energy commodities.

articles.title: Bitcoin, stocks wobble as Fed’s Waller talks of ‘shock’ 50-point rate hike
articles.description: Bitcoin price action dropped below $63,000 after fresh hawkish comments from the Fed as Nvidia earnings optimism faded.

articles.title: Bitcoin Covenants Part 6: FE Covenants — Enforcing covenants through cryptographically restricted signing keys
articles.description: FE covenants encode spending constraints into the signing key, so only transactions that satisfy a predefined condition can be signed.

articles.title: CoinShares sells all treasury ETH, halves SOL holdings for buybacks
articles.description: The October sales raised $19.3 million, nearly half the $40 million CoinShares can spend on buybacks before its next annual meeting.

articles.title: Sanctions fears loom over Russia’s regulated crypto trading launch
articles.description: Russia’s crypto trading rollout faces uncertainty as companies weigh sanctions exposure, while Moscow Exchange prepares to launch crypto trading in December.

articles.title: How to preserve wealth and access funds during a national emergency
articles.description: As geopolitical and technological threats multiply, the big question is whether you can hold on to your wealth and access funds when the system fails.

articles.title: Tokenized Nvidia market cap surges 159% amid Jensen Huang’s exit
articles.description: Nvidia stock tokens reached $401.9 million in combined value as Jensen Huang stepped down and the chipmaker posted record quarterly revenue.

articles.title: Bitwise seeks Texas Stock Exchange listing for Zcash ETF
articles.description: Coinbase Custody would safeguard the fund’s ZEC holdings, while Bitwise Investment Advisers would serve as its manager and sponsor.

articles.title: Bitcoin steadies after Nvidia’s earnings beat as $60K bids stand out
articles.description: Bitcoin halted downside as Nvidia confidence returned, with its stock gaining 3% premarket and South Korea’s tech-heavy KOSPI reclaiming 5,000 points.

articles.title: World Bank partners with Circle, Citi to explore stablecoins for payments
articles.description: The initiative builds on the World Bank’s existing blockchain platform, which aims to create more fund traceability for investments in developing countries.

articles.title: SOL comes out of Breakpoint 7% higher as Solana exits beta
articles.description: Solana’s token reached $75.12 on Tuesday, outpacing Bitcoin and Ether after the network retired the beta label it had used since its 2020 launch.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs lose $240M as CryptoQuant flags bearish market phase
articles.description: Bitcoin ETF outflows returned after a one-day pause as CryptoQuant warned that Bitcoin had returned to a bearish market phase.

articles.title: Ledger hardware implant saga reaches Dubai’s Virgin Megastore
articles.description: Two Ledger owners reported losing a combined $604,000 in crypto from hardware wallets they said were purchased at authorized retailer Virgin Megastore in Dubai.

articles.title: Nvidia board rejects Huang comeback despite record $116B quarter
articles.description: Nvidia beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations by 5.6% and issued a stronger-than-expected sales forecast, while its board resisted growing calls for Jensen Huang’s reinstatement.

articles.title: CFTC halts some Kalshi Trump mention markets over manipulation concerns
articles.description: The CFTC stayed Kalshi’s Trump-related mention markets after raising concerns about manipulation risks, giving the platform until Dec. 11 to defend its contracts.

articles.title: Maple Finance CEO targets up to $15B in assets by the end of 2027
articles.description: Sidney Powell aims to reach $15 billion in assets under management by the end of 2027 as the firm looks to expand into tokenized lending and traditional finance.

articles.title: Eastern Europe crypto flows fall 7.9% as Ukraine draws $12B in stablecoins
articles.description: Chainalysis found that Eastern Europe recorded the steepest decline in crypto activity of any region, while cross-border stablecoin transfers to Ukraine continued amid the ongoing war.

articles.title: Lighter incident exposes risks beyond withdrawal controls
articles.description: Crypto platforms need enforceable limits on every route an API key can use to transfer value, including trades, internal transfers and shared pools.

articles.title: Fed’s Waller cites Binance hack in warning over tokenized finance
articles.description: Fed Governor Christopher Waller questioned who bears responsibility for fraud, compromised keys and failed transactions as traditional financial assets move onto blockchains.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops 2.5% as Nvidia stock risks new 5-month lows into Q3 earnings
articles.description: Bitcoin price downside sees local lows of $63,269 as Nvidia stock targets $150 as traders brace for volatility over Q3 earnings.

articles.title: Solana Foundation takes majority interest in crypto data firm CoinGecko
articles.description: Solana Foundation now holds a majority interest in CoinGecko, its product chief said, as the crypto data platform explores trading features.
